name: The Last Look
source:
You play as Rika - an isolated girl whose life begins to change when a mysterious program called M4R!N.̷̓̕e̷̛͗r̵̍̍r̸̩͊ő̸͝r̸̀̿  installs itself into her computer.

Marin is everything Rika ever wanted: Sweet, caring, and always there. As online hate fades and praise floods in, Rika begins to feel alive again.

[From [url=https://nikopng7.itch.io/the-last-look]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演Rika - 一个孤立的女孩，当一个名为M4R!N.̷̓̕e̷̛͗r̵̍̍r̸̩͊ő̸͝r̸̀̿ 的神秘程序安装到她的电脑中时，她的生活开始改变。

Marin满足了Rika想要的一切：甜蜜、贴心、永远在身边。随着网上仇恨的消退和赞扬的涌入，莉卡开始感觉自己又活过来了。

[来自[url=https://nikopng7.itch.io/the-last-look]Itch.io[/url]]
